lead.event: PACK announces rights issue and two nickel-sector acquisitions
lead.headline: PACK plans Rp8.19 trillion rights issue alongside two nickel acquisitions
lead.blurb: Abadi Nusantara Hijau Investama signed on 22 October to buy 100% of Denway Development and plans to acquire 100% of nickel miner Bumanik for USD79 million. The rights issue would issue up to 100 billion shares at Rp10 each to fund loan repayment, acquisitions and working capital. Controlling shareholder Eco Energi Perkasa will backstop up to Rp7.39 trillion of unsubscribed shares. The issue needs shareholder approval and OJK effectiveness, while independent shareholders must approve the Denway deal at a 30 November 2026 meeting.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: TOBA secures HPS investment commitment for Asian waste-management expansion
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: TOBA secures up to S$555 million HPS commitment for Asian waste expansion
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Funds managed by HPS Investment Partners, part of BlackRock, would invest through staged issuance of preferred shares and other instruments in SBTH Asia Holdings, parent of TBS’s waste platform. The transaction requires shareholder approval at an extraordinary general meeting, for which no date has been reported, while CEO Dicky Yordan says TBS will retain control.

deals_control.event: Beruntung Berkat Sejahtera negotiates majority acquisition of STRK
deals_control.headline: Beruntung Berkat Sejahtera negotiates to buy 61.87% of STRK
deals_control.blurb: Lovina Beach Brewery says negotiations are underway with prospective seller Barito Mas Sukses for 6.63 billion shares. Director Jeremy said the proposed acquisition aims to support business development.

earnings_guidance.event: Adhi Karya reports nine-month 2026 profit growth
earnings_guidance.headline: ADHI reports 247.05% nine-month profit growth to Rp15.34 billion
earnings_guidance.blurb: Adhi Karya reported net profit of Rp15.34 billion for the nine months to 30 September, up 247.05% year on year. Revenue fell 4.95% to Rp5.37 trillion, while basic earnings per share rose to Rp1.82 from Rp0.53.

earnings_guidance.event: Phapros sets 2026 sales and profit growth targets
earnings_guidance.headline: PEHA targets over 20% sales growth and around 23% profit rise in 2026
earnings_guidance.blurb: Phapros projects net profit of Rp33.87 billion and has allocated Rp68.7 billion for capital expenditure. It needs about Rp646.21 billion in additional sales in the second half, after first-half sales rose 5.37% year on year to Rp482.85 billion.
